messages:
yuri: Heads-up: onboarding run for quincy-q5:int4 shows intermittent loss of U+200D (ZWJ) when KVCACHE returns partial prefixes and sampling (top-p) is >0.8. BLEU and chrF drop on the mixed zh/ja subtitle set. Repro: `./evals/run.py --suite locale/multiscript_subs --model quincy-q5 --quant int4 --seed 21`

ci-bot: CI job `evals/quincy-int4-zwj/3039998888` produced regressions. Artifacts: /ci/artifacts/3039998888/eval.log

emma: Reproed locally. FP16 + no-kvcache = clean. int4 + kvcache + top_p>=0.8 => about 1% of lines drop the ZWJ between hanzi and kana, turning e.g. "\u4e2d\u56fd\u200D\u30b5\u30f3" into "\u4e2d\u56fd\u30b5\u30f3". Seems correlated with cache-hit on prefix that ends on grapheme boundary.

rafi: Paste small failing example and tokens if you have them?

yuri: Example + token dump:
```
# src: "\u65e5\u672c\u306e\u4e2d\u56fd\u200D\u30b5\u30f3"
# tokens: [412: "\u65e5", 413:"\u672c", 2:"\u200D", 701:"\u30b5", 702:"\u30f3"]
# fp16 decode: "\u65e5\u672c\u306e\u4e2d\u56fd\u200D\u30b5\u30f3"
# int4 decode (fail): "\u65e5\u672c\u306e\u4e2d\u56fd\u30b5\u30f3"  <-- ZWJ dropped
```

carla: Two quick hypotheses: 1) the int4 decode kernel uses a compact token remap table and the ZWJ id (small id) collides in some vectorized path when stitching cache+new tokens, 2) sampling/top-p and cache combination produce rounding effects that prefer merging the ZWJ into neighbor token if its score is marginal.

emma: I reran with deterministic greedy decoding (top_p=0) and the issue goes away, so sampling interacts somehow. Also reran with `--kvcache=false` and it's fine. So it's specifically the cache+sampling path.

rafi: Can you reproduce with a short script that simulates a cached prefix then a sampled continuation? If so we can add a tiny reproducer test in the evals harness.

yuri: Yep, I added reproducer: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/3039998888/quincy-zwj-repro (includes model hashes and small trace). Output shows steps where cache logits are fused then sampled with top-p; probability for token id 2 hovers near threshold and stochastic rounding drops it.

carla: Short mitigation options: - route affected customers to fp16 - force `decode_options: { preserve_invisible: true }` per-route which marks ZWJ as sticky token that can't be pruned by sampling pruning, - temporarily disable kvcache for locales with mixed-script. Example route patch: 
```yaml
routes:
  - name: quincy-q5-multiscript
    model: quincy-q5:int4
    filters:
      - locales: ["zh-JP","ja-JP"]
    decode_options:
      preserve_invisible: true
```

rafi: I'll instrument the int4 kernel to log pre/post sampling scores for invisible tokens when kvcache is used. If it's a numerical precision issue the kernel fix is small (change softmax eps / threshold behavior). If it's remap collision, that's deeper.

emma: For customer comms I'll offer pin to fp16 or set preserve_invisible. Label any PR `customer-impact` if we flip routing.

yuri: I'll open PR with failing unit test + route patch. Also scheduling a bisect across int4 kernel commits where kvcache-sampling was optimized: `scripts/bisect_kernel.sh --model quincy-q5 --artifact int4 --range kernel-1.0..kernel-1.3`

carla: Good. Prioritize a short mitigation today; full fix next sprint. Thanks everyone. :+1:
